spec: A2UI v0.9 message model (createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel); https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/wayback/go/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fa2ui.org
description: The trusted component catalog for Cedwyn webapps. A surface may use only these components; tools/a2ui_render.py renders them at build time with each app's own CSS classes. Strings are always escaped; links must be root-relative or relative.
binding: A prop is a literal, {"path": "/absolute/pointer"} into the surface data model, {"path": "relative"} into the current template item, or {"fmt": "…{name}…", "args": {name: binding}}. children: [ids] or {"path": list, "componentId": template}.

components.Page: document shell: title, description, css[], headScripts[], js[], bodyClass, mainClass, children
components.Heading: h1–h4 (level, text, className)
components.Text: paragraph (text, label, className); empty text renders nothing
components.Section: section (heading, list, listClass, children); empty renders nothing
components.Card: card (href, kicker, title, meta[{label,value}], bodyLabel, body, badge, badgeClass, foot, attrs{})
components.DetailSections: [{heading, text|items|runs, form: section|term}] → h2 sections and dl terms
